items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: If they wanted to get Miles Davis, they had to get Miles Davis by way of Cannonball Adderley.

ctx.x: Well I was also wondering about the tough times for Blue Note. Was there tough times? I mean when you look at Blue Note, you go oh, man, what a successful label. And unless you really know the realities of the record business, were there tough years for you guys?

From the very beginning to the very end it was tough. It was an independent label they were battling the giants all the way. If they wanted to get Miles Davis, they had to get Miles Davis by way of Cannonball Adderley. One of the best, or most outstanding hits they had, was, I’ve forgotten the name of it —
The early Cannonball, one of the early Cannonball records?
